comment: Declared workload loops (tier 1: no model). Each step is a registered typed action; the order is fixed, so each step's precondition holds by construction. Schema: randomrun/loop.go.

soak.comment: Create and attach every volume of the pool; each iteration, per volume: write 4 random lbas, read them back, every 10th iteration take a snapshot and delete the snapshot taken three snapshots earlier (at most 4 live, under the limit of 10); after the cycle, read back every written lba and observe every volume; last, stop each volume.
